analysis.nulls: 100 NEW T=.7 ordinary completions for all three detectors; no calibration or pooling
analysis.self_bleu: SacreBLEU 2.4.3, decoded text, 13a, exp smoothing, effective order, symmetric two-reference directions /200
analysis.unit: 50 paired prompt clusters, both responses and all arms together

audit.arithmetic_differences_from_original: temperature division only; original BF16 rounding retained
audit.known_differences: Source layout has moved and legacy scoring metadata was corrected; generate_method AST and numerical source files match the original. Depth-2 T=1 responses come from the completed depth follow-up using the same implementation.
audit.temperature_placement: single BF16 model-output adapter; SynthID internal /1 unchanged

cost.estimate_basis: Prior full-vocabulary 8B generation/replay timings; top-100 PRC timing is a conservative generation proxy. Add 150 seconds for validation/loading and 25% timing margin.

precision.fallback: softmax(scaled_BF16_logits.float()), exactly ordinary distribution on the same history
precision.model: existing BF16 weights/forward on H100, static KV cache
precision.ordinary: scaled BF16 logits -> float32 -> softmax -> existing multinomial
precision.prc: BF16 softmax, BF16 partition multiplication and bucket sum; FP32 channel; FP64 bucket uniform; FP32 masked conditional softmax/CDF and token uniform
precision.replay: original BF16 completion-only bucket path with the same single BF16 temperature scaling; no clipping/repair of bucket masses
precision.synthid: internal temperature remains 1; BF16 score updates; FP32 final sampling softmax; native zero context, state reset and repeat fallback
precision.temperature: divide BF16 logits by Python float .7 once, retaining BF16, before existing samplers

stop_rule: One 400-response T=.7 batch after passing validation, then analysis and STOP regardless of outcome. No other temperatures/configurations, prompts or threshold changes.

validation.failure_action: Stop and report; no full generation or automatic validation retry
